purpose: Opaque publication of completed public V258/V259 audits; no scientific recomputation.
authorization: Only an explicit Root true entry with RootapprovedPublicPointTeacherPublication=true and exact helper SHA authorizes execution.
package_contract: Caller supplies the full exact allowlist including historical failed-parser V1/proofs/public raw/geometry/r-q ledgers/QA/figures/docs/helper CODE. No discovery or outcome filtering.
Fresh exclusive output; raw bytes copied in 1MiB blocks and SHA/size checked. No compression, image/array/model loader or decoder.
MANIFEST.json embeds the original entry UTF8 and path/SHA/size binding, every source file SHA/size/original binding, and generated STARTED.json SHA/size.
README_KO.md is a mandatory explicit source because registry links point to it. Manifest/FAILURE/STARTED root names are reserved.
No payload contents or teacher labels are interpreted. No original Source payload fallback during package verification.
stage_contract: Use identical entry bytes for package and stage. Exact local HEAD and live origin refs/heads/main must equal fixed parent; tracked working tree and index must be clean.
Verify every package file and original entry binding; copy only manifest allowlist plus MANIFEST into a fresh repository destination.
Prepend exactly three Korean registry links; prior HEAD suffixes remain exact bytes. Wording states public two-frame teacher pilot, not model accuracy, training0, latest model comparison V256.

Use literal NUL pathspec exact git add allowlist; compare complete cached pathset, every working file and every index blob SHA/size. Direct blob==working-file bytes equality is additionally required for every staged file.
Whitespace check only exact package root files, tools/ files and three registries; archived artifact/assets/references bytes are never normalized.
Return staged tree and STAGED_QA receipt outside repository/package. No commit, push, force push, automatic retry or cleanup of partial failure.
guards: Case-insensitive v112/cache/.pyc and traversal rejected before root-first ancestor symlink checks; no arbitrary tree walk.
failure_contract: False approval fails before payload/Git/output work. After fresh actual output/receipt creation, any processing failure writes FAILURE.json and preserves partial artifacts/state; pre-existing outputs are never overwritten.
version_note: V1 preparation preserved. V2 adds one explicit staged-blob == working-file byte comparison after existing SHA/size checks; no actual run or failed scientific operation.
